description: Record the user's answer to a flashcard and reschedule it (SM-2 spaced repetition) — exactly the same as rating it in the web app, and it counts toward their activity calendar and streak. Also use this when the user says they already know a card ("easy" pushes it days ahead). Returns the card's new schedule. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

rating.description: How well the USER recalled it: again = forgot, hard = recalled with real difficulty, good = recalled, easy = instant. Use "easy" when the user says they already know the card well.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

name: review_memo_card
